If rural or semi-urban branch posting is a genuine non-starter for your family situation, that alone can settle the decision toward SSC.
If you need more attempt opportunities per year to feel secure about the risk, bank exams (IBPS plus SBI plus RRB) give you more cycles.

blocks.heading: Mistakes to Avoid When Making This Decision

items.text: Quant, reasoning, and English overlap enough that light cross-preparation is fine, but static GK, banking awareness, and each exam's specific pattern and difficulty curve are different enough that splitting serious mock-test time across both usually means being mediocre at both instead of strong at one.
A screenshot of an SBI PO CTC figure or an SSC CGL Assistant Commissioner's eventual pay level is not the entry-level reality.
Bank branch postings and SSC departmental transfers are structural, not optional extras.

A recruitment channel for central government departments, Income Tax, Central Excise/GST, Customs, CBI, Ministry of External Affairs, Audit and Accounts, and dozens of others, through SSC CGL (graduate-level, Group B/C posts) and SSC CHSL (12th-pass-level, Group C posts like LDC/JSA and DEO).

A recruitment channel for public sector bank officer and clerk posts through IBPS (common exam for 11 public sector banks) and SBI's own separate PO and Clerk exams. You end up working inside one specific bank, not a general government cadre.

figures.label: Estimated Time Required
figures.source: If your family or financial runway cannot absorb 1-2 years of exam-focused prep without income, that constraint should weigh as heavily as which exam "suits your brain" better. Building a parallel, high-income skill, something you can freelance or monetise while you prepare, protects that runway and moves you toward financial freedom even before results are out.
